subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

I4D ∶ G9F ∶∶ L16S ∶ J25U ∶∶ W64R ∶ ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

 
• In this type of question, The same logic gets followed in pairs 1, 2 and 3.
 
• In this question, the first letter in pair 1 is I which got converted to G (two positional values back) and this happened with all the first letters of each pair.
 
• The second digit in each pair is the consecutive square of numbers 3 & 4, 4 & 5 and 8 & 9.
 
• the last letter in pair 1 is D which got converted to F (two positional values ahead) and this happened with all the last letters of each pair.

 

 
• **I4D ∶ G9F**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67835fab06d0e394e5016a305fd993aabfa4fcd94c5f141945638eadc3d691ed.png] 

And,

 
• **L16S ∶ J25U**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6564d4f03ec9f807bd2b6666b79cf0164b0c5cf99ee242fc424edbeb867d289.png] 

Similarly,

 
• **W64R ∶ **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50ed0ed9a3b09b6cabc97e287f2395efcee7c3752ef8414b501f72ae9cf83d6d.png] 

Hence, "**U81T**" is the correct answer.
